title: Fill out a foreign bank account report with an agent
summary: A founder had an agent styled after Warren Buffett walk them through their FBAR bank account form and fill it in; they say it took 5 minutes.
agent_role: The agent guided the process and filled in the form. The human entered a couple of critical details and clicked submit.
outcome: Author reports the FBAR was done in 5 minutes.
what_they_did: A founder runs a set of advisor agents, each modeled on a famous person, inside a platform called @bot. One is modeled on Warren Buffett. They asked it to help file their FBAR, a form for reporting foreign bank accounts. It walked them through and filled in the form, leaving key details for the founder to type in.
how_it_went: The author says the whole filing took 5 minutes. They clicked submit themselves.
worth_knowing: The agent left the most important details for the person to fill in. Keep sensitive account information and the final submit button in your own hands.
prompt: Help me file my FBAR (FinCEN 114) for [tax year]. Ask me which foreign accounts I hold and their maximum balances. Walk me through each section and draft the entries. Leave account numbers and other sensitive fields for me to enter. Show me the completed form for review and do not submit anything until I approve.

curation.rationale: A genuine agent action: it filled out a whole tax form, with the human submitting it. But the post is brief and somewhat promotional, with few specifics.
